research_question: Does causal pre-09:35 tick flow predict cross-sectional returns over 30 minutes, 60 minutes, or the remainder of the session?

data_contract.universe: quarterly PIT market-cap top500 intersected with daily PIT eligibility and ADV20 >= 10m; causal broad opening-event ticker-days; old/manual 62 unused
data_contract.signal: Polygon tick trades with sip_timestamp strictly before 09:35 ET; tick-rule warmup begins 09:25
data_contract.fixed_exits: 10:10 for 30m, 10:40 for 60m, 15:55 for EOD; missing scheduled bar fills at first later same-session five-minute open without changing membership
data_contract.locked_validation: 2022-01-01 through 2022-12-30, opened only for one development passer

hypotheses.score: total pre-09:35 tick-rule dollar flow imbalance

hypotheses.threshold: absolute score >= 0.20 and large-trade dollar share >= 0.70

hypotheses.score: TRF flow imbalance minus lit flow imbalance
hypotheses.threshold: TRF dollar share >= 0.10 and absolute score >= 0.30

hypotheses.score: same-day PIT cross-sectional percentile rank of flow imbalance minus percentile rank of first-five return
hypotheses.direction: long positive divergence, short negative divergence

selection.rank: absolute frozen score times sqrt(capped rvol930) times sqrt(capped absolute first5 shock)
selection.book: exactly 3 longs and 3 shorts or no trade
selection.sic_cap: one ticker per SIC per side
selection.weights: equal 1/6 absolute NAV per ticker, 1x gross dollar neutral

development_gate.winner: highest base-cost Sharpe then CAGR among passers

multiple_testing_policy: Exactly five fixed score/horizon rows. No post-result horizon, score, threshold, direction, book-size, or weighting changes.
production_policy: A validation pass permits further audit only, never an immediate production PASS.
